source.title: Algorithmic management and working conditions in Europe. Evidence from the AIM-WORK Survey
source.retrieval_note: Core cells transcribed from the publicly readable full text; official JRC repository record is the canonical publication locator.

unit: employees in all 27 EU Member States
model: Table 2 note: ordered logistic regression; average marginal effects shown
analysis_methods_section: The methods section describes multinomial logit models as the primary specification and OLS as a robustness test.
controls_reported_by_paper: trade union or staff representative presence
model_audit: The methods section and Table 2 note use different model labels; the compact record preserves this unresolved wording difference.
significance: *** p<0.01; ** p<0.05; * p<0.10; no marker means not statistically significant
boundary: The published cells are associations from a cross-sectional worker survey. This compact record does not include standard errors, sample counts per cell, full outcome categories, country-specific estimates, or a causal estimand. Signs must be interpreted with the paper's ordinal coding; estimates are not percentage-point changes in a population outcome.
